description: China's major export or import commodities in quantity and value (crude oil, soybeans, iron ore, steel, machinery, vehicles, chips and more), for the month and year-to-date, with published percentage change — from the General Administration of Customs (GACC) official English monthly bulletin, table 13 (exports) / 14 (imports). Defaults to the latest published month; the response lists `available_months`, so a month GACC has not yet released is reported as unavailable rather than guessed. Values in US$1,000. Optional `commodity` text filter. 中国海关总署主要进出口商品量值表。

commodity.description: Optional filter on the commodity line, e.g. "crude oil", "soybean", "steel".

month.description: Month as "YYYY-MM", e.g. "2026-08". Omit for the latest published month.

name: china_trade_major_commodities
title: China Trade Major Commodities
